gaps.sentence: This job calls ___ someone with patience.
gaps.explanation: call for = require, demand (circumstances call for action).

gaps.sentence: The chairman walked ___ of the meeting when the press arrived.
gaps.explanation: 'Walk out of' = leave suddenly, often to show disapproval.

gaps.sentence: Don't leave ___ any details in your report.
Feel free to drop ___ for a coffee any time.
gaps.explanation: drop in = pay a casual visit; drop off = fall asleep or deliver.

gaps.sentence: They broke ___ after only two years of marriage.
The caterpillar will turn ___ a butterfly.
The film didn't live up ___ my expectations.
gaps.explanation: live up TO something = be as good as expected.
